notes.title: The Ants' Sweet Secret: Aphids Revealed! 🐜🌿
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41491811/a2ce53e33828b6161b426e6d491ecda39d304f34.png[/img]

Welcome to the captivating world of SuperColony, where the delightful companions, Aphids, await your care and attention. These adorable creatures are more than just a pretty sight; they play a vital role in your colony's survival. As ladybugs threaten to feast on them, you become their protector, ensuring they remain safe from harm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41491811/1635a9dc4ebde01226dd5ecd930a877a2c1a2af5.gif[/img]

But the rewards for your benevolence are beyond imagination! Aphids are like tiny sugar factories, producing the precious nectar called Honeydew. This golden elixir fuels your ants' growth and prosperity, making them stronger with each drop. Witness the magic of your colony flourishing, powered by these tiny sweet friends!

Now, brace yourself for a strategic quandary! Will you opt for sustainable harmony by farming the Aphids, nurturing them as your valuable asset? Or, does your strategy favor a protein-packed feast as you hunt down the Aphids? The choice is yours, and your colony's destiny is at stake.

But wait, there's more! The Aphids double as your ultimate defense system. Their presence deters ladybugs from targeting your ants directly. The Ladybugs will target the Aphids first, so use that to your advantage. Strategically fortify their surroundings and lay clever traps for those hungry predators to ensure your colony's safety.

We value your feedback, so please let us know your thoughts in the comments below!

notes.title: Terrifying neighbour alert: Ladybug invasion!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41491811/ea8f7e53af18b11c13d602591e5580c9d268a742.png[/img]

In the fascinating world of SuperColony, players will encounter not only different species of ants but also other insects from the tiny world. Let's take a look at one of the first creatures you'll encounter: The Ladybug.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41491811/1635a9dc4ebde01226dd5ecd930a877a2c1a2af5.gif[/img]

While ladybugs in SuperColony are generally passive, they may attack ants if they spot something they desire, like food, especially aphids. As the player, it's your responsibility to protect your precious aphids and food stores from these hungry invaders.

With their sturdy shells, ladybugs pose formidable challenges. However, here's the exciting part - if you manage to defeat them, you can evolve your ants to acquire similar shells, boosting your defenses and making your ants fearless warriors on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41491811/7f250b1fd961e70305fe385cf58d1d7be8e5d065.gif[/img]

notes.title: Evolve your ants, and shape your colony destiny!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41491811/5cd30585063b3ef143ced87ddfa3a6fe09897ea1.png[/img]

Have you ever experienced playing other colony simulation games where all your units seem identical? If so, SuperColony offers a refreshing and unique experience by providing a wide variety of ants with distinct characteristics and abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41491811/6d7ab66f9543bb24da81beca2893c2439f174508.png[/img]

In SuperColony, the individual components of an ant play a crucial role in determining its capabilities. For example, equipping your ant with Ladybug arms enhances their defence, while powerful jaws enable them to effectively dismantle enemies. In some cases, certain parts may even grant the ability to explode or unleash toxic floral attacks upon foes!

However, the influence of these parts doesn't end there. Each component also affects an ant's behaviour within the colony. Workers and non-combatant ants may be naturally inclined to flee from danger, prioritizing the colony's safety. On the other hand, warriors exhibit steadfast determination, standing their ground to protect their kin. Interestingly, some ants might even willingly sacrifice themselves for the greater good of the colony, displaying a remarkable sense of dedication and unity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41491811/c50dde235cd722bbd11a8e862f6e5279cfa77b05.gif[/img]

Did you enjoy this content? Let us know in the comments below!

notes.title: The secret of ant communication revealed!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41491811/3e1cadd23cc9cc6a5bece0b39bb0770fe461c3c4.png[/img]

In nature, whenever an ant has something worth communicating to the rest of the colony, they make a new pheromone marker. They do this for food, threats, and even new locations for homes!

In SuperColony, you will use pheromones to direct your colony too! You will place markers with control over range and importance. Those markers send the signal you want to the entire colony AI, and then they will determine which ants are the best for the job!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41491811/61a3080eb925aed82094c88cc5a37c98fb3f7b6c.jpg[/img]

You can set different types of pheromones, from Exploration to Harvest and War, down to more specific options within each, like Guarding and Patrolling within the War pheromone.

In nature, ants place pheromones when they encounter something important, and then they run back to the colony, leaving behind them a trail. The message of what they found is embedded in the chemicals that make the trail up! Isn’t that so clever? The trail both leads you to the destination and tells you what you will find when you get there! Ants truly are clever little creatures..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41491811/f6075ec450e1d6a20d0a4aa4e5eefd5ccedfd8a8.jpg[/img]

In SuperColony, your ants help you too by [b]automatically[/b] placing pheromone markers at key points of interest, like when they find new food or something threatening or curious. The rest of the colony will respond to these pheromones, heading off to collect resources or preparing for battle. 

[h3]Intriguing Smells[/h3]
So far, we have talked about how you and your colony will place pheromones. There is another type of smell in SuperColony that utilizes this same pheromone system, but you do not control it. 

Your enemies and extensive food collections give off smells that travel through the world. Your ants can detect those smells and begin a search in that direction if they think the clue is worth investigating. Otherwise, they might place a guard pheromone if it seems like it may be a threat. 

Since you will also be able to see those curious smell effects wafting through the air, you may place an exploration pheromone out in the distant fog for the colony to respond to, searching for risk and riches. This system is a large part of the feel of our gameplay; it will allow you to focus on the strategy while also having the time to enjoy watching the grand drama found within the tiny world of SuperColony.

Hungry for more? If you enjoyed this content, please let us know in the comments below!

notes.title: What do we fight for? Sugar!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41491811/9a1d56bf94dd231635abf2b97f3c184e0aaed7a6.png[/img]

In SuperColony, you will need to manage your colony following similar principles. After your Queen consumes enough protein, she can produce larva. Then you set the required caste that needs to be grown. Tip - The bigger and stronger the ant, the more protein required.. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41491811/33434e7ba1880f13b59fdef1148670425ccbfaa9.gif[/img]

You will also need to watch signs of hunger levels. The Colony, in fact– all creatures are emotive, indicating to you and those around them when they are hungry. If you have access to enough food to feed everyone, you can grow your numbers. Maybe, stock carbs in advance.. just don’t let anyone find out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41491811/f21aa190b888ae16575a6368b6a0c7be0408205b.png[/img]

This strategy applies in times of peace... In the time of war hunger could be the last thing you consider before sending your troops to protect the Queen. One bonus is that you can eat most of the things that you defend your colony against! Goodluck out there!

Thanks for reading! We will be doing dev updates bi-weekly moving forward.

Don't forget to wishlist and follow SuperColony💚
